content:
Sam: Thanks for the great Qs in today's all-hands. Dropping a short, actionable summary for API, Console, and Optimize + owners.

Leah: API runtime v2: internal canary next Tue, partner pilot ~3w after, GA ~6w after pilot. Opt-in only via header `X-Redwood-API-Version: v2` or `?api_version=v2`. Pinned model versions stay on v1 unless opted in.

Ivy: Will streaming change break existing webhook consumers?

Leah: Minor streaming frame addition for partial function args; behavior kept backwards-compatible for 90 days after GA. We'll publish migration snippets and SDK PRs right after internal canary.

Carlos: Dedicated/Private customers ask about maintenance windows.

Leah: Dedicated: control-plane rollout then rolling node updates; most upgrades non-disruptive. Private gets an upgrade package + checklist to run on customer schedule. We'll provide per-customer windows.

Sam: Console status please? People want cost-by-route and canary controls.

Ivy: Console beta (internal + pilot partners) mid-May, public opt-in beta late-May, GA end of Q2. Beta includes per-route token cost, latency percentiles, and a simple canary manager with rollback.

Carlos: Optimize timing? Batching vs quantization?

Leah: Batching/caching advisor -> internal alpha in ~2 sprints, public alpha by month-end. Quantization recommender (per-model quality + cost deltas) targeted for Q3. We'll publish an RFC + sample eval sets beforehand.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: "canary: runtime-v2 -> alpha-cluster at 2067890185"

Sam: Action items: 1) @Leah publish timeline + migration checklist by EOD tomorrow. 2) @Ivy open SDK PRs and add webhook examples. 3) @Carlos prepare Dedicated/Private notice templates for CS. 4) Product to publish beta invite flow.

Leah: I'll post the doc to #eng and update public roadmap.

Ivy: Queuing SDK PRs; will include short migration snippets.

Carlos: Will sync maintenance language with CS & Sales and share templates.

Sam: If anyone's panel question isn't covered, paste it here and we'll route to the owner. :thumbsup:
